Good to know

Is the review independent?Yes. Paying gets you placement, not a better verdict. Sponsored slots are always labeled.
One sponsor per category?Yes. Category and trade-guide sponsorships are exclusive while your plan is active. Featured Partner spots are limited to two at a time.
What does the 3-month minimum mean?Category and Category + Featured plans run for at least three months so the banner has time to work. Trade Guide and Featured Spot have no minimum beyond the first month.
How do I send my details?After checkout, email mainstreettools@gmail.com with your logo, link, tool name, which category or guide you want, and a one-line pitch (or reply to your Stripe receipt). We go live within 2 business days and confirm by email. Full steps: After you pay.
Who reads MainStreetAI?Owners and office managers of local service businesses shopping for tools that catch missed calls, book jobs, and keep books clean.
